title: How to read a launch campaign before it lands
author: Editorial
excerpt: Campaigns telegraph their peaks weeks early if you know which signals to read. Here is a field guide for makers.
body:
Every launch leaves fingerprints: domain registrations, hiring posts, teaser pages, and influencer seeding. Read them in sequence, not isolation.

Week minus four is positioning — who they say the product is for. Week minus two is proof — demos, unboxings, founder threads. Launch week is urgency — countdowns, caps, and channel blitz.

Your job is not to copy the campaign. It is to find the moment they cannot serve: the buyer who wants the ritual, the accessory, or the faster path.

Document object, audience, and window in one line. If you cannot write that line, you are not ready to ship. Futura Nota turns those lines into kits you can import and launch inside the same window.
